text.en:
Police Force Act
(CHAPTER 235)
Creation of PSA Corporation Auxiliary Police Force
It is hereby notified for general information that, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 71(1) of the Police Force Act, the Commissioner of Police, with the approval of the Minister for Home Affairs, has authorised the creation of the PSA Corporation Auxiliary Police Force, with effect from 1st October 1997.
